UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_volume_tooltip: Volume of this mod's own sounds (minigames, crafting bars, grade reveal), in steps: 0 = off, 0.25 - 2 (1 = normal).
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_mute_tooltip: Silence this mod's sounds. The megaphone button in the crafting window does the same.
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpBar_tooltip: A health bar over every zombie you can see within 15 tiles. Drawn under every window. The server must allow it (sandbox, TWA 1).
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpText_tooltip: The zombie's HP as numbers (current / full), multiplied by the server's display multiplier. The server must allow it (sandbox, TWA 1).
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpDamage_toolti: The damage of each hit rises from the zombie (yours, and nearby players' when the server shares them). A critical hit is bigger, in its own colour, with "!". The server must allow it (sandbox, TWA 1).
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpHeight_toolti: Raise the bar and HP numbers higher above the zombie's head (0 = lowest).
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpBarColor_tool: Health: green -> yellow -> red as it drops. Or one fixed colour.
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpBarWidth_tool: Width of the bar in pixels.
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpBarThick_tool: Height of the bar in pixels.
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpNumSize_toolt: Text size of the damage numbers (a critical hit is one size bigger).
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpNumHeight_too: Raise the damage numbers higher above the zombie (0 = lowest).
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_zhpLog_tooltip: Writes every hit you land to console.txt: the weapon's listed damage, the damage really dealt, crit, your skill in that weapon and your endurance. For checking why a hit is lower than the tooltip.
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_uiFontSize_toolt: Text size in the weapon crafting, weapon parts and gem socket windows. Reopen the window after changing it.
UI_options_HARMONIE_TWA_uiWindowSize_too: Size of the weapon crafting window. Auto makes it bigger on a big screen (1440p and up). Bigger sizes also bring bigger text. Reopen the window after changing it.
